title: JavaScript basics: closures, this and new
titleZh: JavaScript 基础：闭包、this 与 new
summary: Short scripts that show how closures, `this` and object construction really work.
summaryZh: 用几段短脚本，看懂闭包、`this` 和对象构造的真实行为。

title: call, apply and bind by hand
summary: Rebuild call, apply and bind to see how a function decides what `this` is.
summaryZh: 自己实现 call、apply 和 bind，看懂函数调用时 `this` 是怎么确定的。

title: new and instanceof by hand
summary: Rebuild `new` and `instanceof`: create the object, run the constructor, walk the prototype chain.
summaryZh: 自己实现 `new` 和 `instanceof`：创建对象、执行构造函数、沿原型链查找。

title: What class extends does under the hood
titleZh: class extends 背后做了什么
summary: Compare `class extends` with old-style function inheritance, including why static members are inherited too.
summaryZh: 对比 `class extends` 和老式函数继承，包括静态成员为什么也会被继承。

title: Promise chains vs async/await
titleZh: Promise 链与 async/await 对照
summary: The same two-step calculation written with `.then()` and with `await`.
summaryZh: 同一个两步计算，分别用 `.then()` 和 `await` 来写。

title: Event propagation and the event loop
summary: Watch events bubble, then predict and check the order of tasks, microtasks and timers.
summaryZh: 先看事件如何冒泡，再预测并验证任务、微任务和定时器的执行顺序。

title: Moving an element: layout vs transform
titleZh: 移动元素：改布局还是用 transform
summary: Move the same box with `top` and with `transform`, and see which one makes the browser redo layout.
summaryZh: 分别用 `top` 和 `transform` 移动同一个方块，看哪种会让浏览器重新计算布局。

title: CSS layout: BFC, Grid and centering
summary: Block formatting contexts, grid placement and several ways to center an element.
summaryZh: 块格式化上下文、Grid 布局，以及几种居中方法。

title: Semantic HTML
summary: Build a page from meaningful sections instead of anonymous boxes.
summaryZh: 用有含义的标签搭页面，而不是一堆没有含义的盒子。

title: Promise from scratch
summary: Grow a Promise in three steps, from a tiny state machine to a version that passes all 872 official Promises/A+ tests.
summaryZh: 分三步写出 Promise：从最小的状态机，到通过全部 872 项 Promises/A+ 官方测试的版本。

title: How generators pause and resume
summary: See the state machine that Babel turns `yield` into, and how values flow in and out.
summaryZh: 看 Babel 把 `yield` 编译成的状态机，以及值是怎样传进传出的。

title: Design patterns in small examples
summary: Singleton, factory, adapter, proxy and publish/subscribe, each in a few lines.
summaryZh: 单例、工厂、适配器、代理、发布订阅，每个只用几行代码。

title: Prototype inheritance, including the mistakes
titleZh: 原型继承，以及常见的错误写法
summary: See what goes wrong with a shared prototype or a borrowed constructor, and how `Object.create` fixes it.
summaryZh: 看共享原型和借用构造函数会出什么问题，以及 `Object.create` 怎样解决。

title: Proxy traps and event delegation
summary: Intercept property access with `Proxy`, and handle many clicks from one parent element.
summaryZh: 用 `Proxy` 拦截属性读写，用一个父元素处理所有子元素的点击。

title: Publish and subscribe
summary: A minimal `on` / `emit` / `off` event hub; senders never need to know who is listening.
summaryZh: 一个最小的 `on` / `emit` / `off` 事件中心，发送方不需要知道谁在监听。

title: Everyday utilities by hand
summary: Debounce, throttle, deep clone and more, written as short algorithms with clear limits.
summaryZh: 防抖、节流、深拷贝等，写成边界清楚的短算法。

title: Shallow copy vs deep clone
summary: Copy an object graph while keeping shared references and cycles, then compare with `structuredClone`.
summaryZh: 复制对象图时保留共享引用和循环引用，再和 `structuredClone` 对比。

title: Detecting circular references
summary: Tell a real cycle apart from an object that is referenced twice.
summaryZh: 区分真正的循环引用，和只是被引用了两次的对象。

title: Debounce
summary: Wait until a burst of calls stops, then run once.
summaryZh: 等一连串调用停下来之后，只执行一次。

title: Throttle
summary: Run at most once per interval; the first call goes through right away.
summaryZh: 每个时间间隔最多执行一次，第一次调用立即执行。

title: Why timers drift, and how to correct them
titleZh: 定时器为什么会漂移，以及如何校正
summary: Measure how late timer callbacks arrive and adjust the next deadline.
summaryZh: 测量定时器回调晚了多少，并据此调整下一次的触发时间。

title: Thousands separators without losing precision
titleZh: 千分位格式化，不丢精度
summary: Group the digits of a number string without converting it to `Number`; compare with `Intl.NumberFormat`.
summaryZh: 不把数字字符串转成 `Number` 也能加千分位；再和 `Intl.NumberFormat` 对比。

title: add(1)(2)(3): currying and type coercion
summary: Keep a running total in a closure, and see how a function turns into a number.
summaryZh: 用闭包累加，再看一个函数是怎么变成数字的。

title: webpack, one feature at a time
summary: A set of small builds, each changing one thing: entries, loaders, source maps, hot reload, splitting, caching and more.
summaryZh: 一组小构建，每个只改一处：入口、loader、source map、热更新、拆包、缓存等。

title: Your first webpack build
summary: One entry file becomes one bundle; follow the dependency graph in between.
summaryZh: 一个入口文件打包成一个文件，看中间的依赖图是怎么走的。

title: Loading CSS, images and data
titleZh: 加载 CSS、图片和数据文件
summary: Import CSS, an SVG and an XML file, and see which loader or asset type handles each one.
summaryZh: 导入 CSS、SVG 和 XML，看各自由哪种 loader 或资源类型处理。

title: Multiple entry points
summary: Two entries produce two named files, and the HTML plugin adds their script tags for you.
summaryZh: 两个入口生成两个文件，HTML 插件自动插入对应的 script 标签。

title: Source maps for debugging
summary: Build in development mode and read your original source in DevTools.
summaryZh: 用开发模式构建，在 DevTools 里看到原始源码。

title: Hot module replacement
summary: Edit a module while the dev server runs, and the page updates without a reload.
summaryZh: 开发服务器运行时修改模块，页面不刷新就能更新。

title: Lazy loading with import()
summary: A module is downloaded only when you click the button.
summaryZh: 点击按钮时才下载对应的模块。

title: Sharing code between entries
summary: Two entries share one copy of Lodash instead of bundling it twice.
summaryZh: 两个入口共享一份 Lodash，不再各打包一份。

title: Content hashes for long-term caching
titleZh: 用内容哈希做长期缓存
summary: File names change only when their content changes, so browsers can cache them safely.
summaryZh: 只有内容变了文件名才变，浏览器就能放心缓存。

title: Development vs production builds
summary: One project, two configs: readable output for debugging, optimized output for users.
summaryZh: 同一个项目两套配置：调试用可读的输出，发布用优化后的输出。

title: Tree shaking: dropping unused exports
titleZh: Tree shaking：去掉没用到的导出
summary: Import one function and watch the unused one disappear from the production bundle.
summaryZh: 只导入一个函数，看没用到的那个从生产包里消失。

title: Shimming old global-style code
titleZh: 为旧式全局代码做适配（shimming）
summary: Give legacy code the global it expects, even though it never imports it.
summaryZh: 给从不 import 的旧代码提供它依赖的全局变量。

title: Writing a webpack plugin
summary: A plugin that hooks into the build and writes a list of every output file.
summaryZh: 一个接入构建流程、输出全部产物清单的插件。

title: Publishing a library with webpack
titleZh: 用 webpack 打包一个库
summary: Package a tiny number-to-word converter as a library and load it from a separate Node program.
summaryZh: 把一个很小的数字与英文单词互转工具打包成库，再在另一个 Node 程序里加载。

title: Build your own bundler, two ways
summary: Parse imports, build a dependency graph and emit one file: first as plain functions, then as a small compiler.
summaryZh: 解析 import、构建依赖图、输出一个文件；先用几个函数写，再改成一个小型编译器。

title: Grunt: task-based builds
summary: A clean-then-copy build, the way many projects worked before bundlers.
summaryZh: 先清理再复制的构建流程，打包器流行之前很多项目就是这样构建的。

title: Less, and what native CSS can do today
titleZh: Less，以及今天原生 CSS 能做到的
summary: Variables, mixins and guards in Less, and why native CSS variables can change at runtime while Less variables cannot.
summaryZh: Less 的变量、混入和条件守卫；以及为什么原生 CSS 变量能在运行时改变，而 Less 变量不能。

title: Template compiling and HTML escaping
titleZh: 模板编译与 HTML 转义
summary: Compile a Handlebars template and see why `{{value}}` is escaped while `{{{value}}}` is not.
summaryZh: 编译 Handlebars 模板，看为什么 `{{value}}` 会转义而 `{{{value}}}` 不会。

title: TypeScript: typed actions and reducers
titleZh: TypeScript：给 action 和 reducer 加类型
summary: A discriminated union tells the compiler which action each branch of a reducer handles.
summaryZh: 用可辨识联合类型，让编译器知道 reducer 的每个分支处理的是哪种 action。

title: Gulp: running tasks in order
summary: Clean, compile TypeScript and copy HTML as a small Gulp pipeline.
summaryZh: 用一条小的 Gulp 流水线完成清理、编译 TypeScript 和复制 HTML。

title: TypeScript and React through webpack
titleZh: 通过 webpack 使用 TypeScript 和 React
summary: See why Babel strips types without checking them, and where `tsc` still fits in.
summaryZh: 看懂 Babel 为什么只删类型不检查，以及 `tsc` 还负责什么。

title: One component library, three builds
titleZh: 一个组件库，三种构建方式
summary: Ship the same Card and Button with Vite, webpack and Babel, and load each output.
summaryZh: 同一组 Card 和 Button，分别用 Vite、webpack 和 Babel 构建，并实际加载每种产物。

title: Build your own React-style renderer
titleZh: 手写一个 React 风格的渲染器
summary: createElement, mount and setState in a few files; two counters keep their own state.
summaryZh: 用几个文件实现 createElement、挂载和 setState；两个计数器各自保存状态。

title: Build your own router
summary: A small router on the History API: links, back and forward, all without a page reload.
summaryZh: 基于 History API 的小路由：点击链接、前进后退，都不刷新页面。

title: Function composition (compose)
summary: The `compose` helper behind Redux middleware, written by hand.
summaryZh: Redux 中间件背后的 `compose`，自己写一遍。

title: Cursors and selections in editable text
titleZh: 可编辑文本里的光标与选区
summary: Save the cursor before focus leaves, insert text at it, and restore it after re-rendering.
summaryZh: 在失去焦点前保存光标，在光标处插入文字，重新渲染后再恢复光标。

title: Todo app, 2018 style: classes, Redux, Saga, Immutable
summary: The original architecture, repaired and running on React 19.
summaryZh: 原来的架构，修好后运行在 React 19 上。

title: Todo app, today's style: Hooks, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit
summary: The same features as the 2018 version, so the two can be compared side by side.
summaryZh: 功能和 2018 版完全相同，方便两边对照阅读。

title: Rich text with Draft.js (archived)
titleZh: 用 Draft.js 做富文本（已归档）
summary: Type, bold and save as JSON with the editor Meta archived in 2023.
summaryZh: 输入、加粗、保存为 JSON；Draft.js 已于 2023 年被 Meta 归档。

title: Rich text with Lexical
summary: The same type, bold and save steps with Draft.js's successor.
summaryZh: 同样的输入、加粗、保存流程，换成 Draft.js 的继任者。

title: React architecture notes from 2018
titleZh: 2018 年的 React 架构笔记
summary: The original notes (in Chinese) on domain-driven structure, sagas and routing.
summaryZh: 原始的中文笔记：领域驱动的目录结构、saga 与路由。

title: React testing the old way: TestUtils and Enzyme
titleZh: 老式 React 测试：TestUtils 与 Enzyme
summary: Shallow rendering and DOM tests from an older tutorial, kept for comparison with Testing Library.
summaryZh: 来自早年教程的浅渲染和 DOM 测试，留作与 Testing Library 对比。

title: JSONP vs fetch with CORS
titleZh: JSONP 与 fetch + CORS 对照
summary: Read the same cross-origin data two ways, and cancel a request with `AbortController`.
summaryZh: 用两种方式读取同一份跨域数据，并用 `AbortController` 取消请求。

title: Offline pages with a service worker
titleZh: 用 Service Worker 实现离线访问
summary: Register, cache, serve offline and clean up, without a framework.
summaryZh: 不依赖框架，完成注册、缓存、离线访问和清理。

title: GraphQL from scratch over HTTP
titleZh: 从零搭一个 GraphQL HTTP 服务
summary: Schema, resolvers and a JSON response: the smallest complete GraphQL request.
summaryZh: Schema、resolver 和 JSON 响应：最小的一次完整 GraphQL 请求。

title: Full-stack GraphQL: Apollo, subscriptions and SQLite
summary: A small link feed with sign-up, voting, pagination and live updates.
summaryZh: 一个小型链接分享站：注册登录、投票、分页和实时更新。

title: The GraphQL server and database
summary: Apollo Server, Prisma and SQLite, rebuilt from migrations and a fictional seed.
summaryZh: Apollo Server + Prisma + SQLite，用迁移脚本和虚构数据重建。

title: The Apollo Client app
summary: Queries, mutations and live subscriptions from a Vite app.
summaryZh: 在 Vite 应用里发起查询、变更和实时订阅。

title: Rust to WebAssembly in the browser
summary: Compile a Rust function to `.wasm` and call it from a button.
summaryZh: 把一个 Rust 函数编译成 `.wasm`，再通过按钮调用它。

title: Dot-matrix countdown on canvas
summary: Digits drawn from a grid of dots; when a digit changes, its dots fall away as particles.
summaryZh: 用点阵画出数字；数字变化时，点会化作粒子落下。

title: Image effects with canvas pixels
titleZh: 用 Canvas 像素做图像处理
summary: Scale, watermark, magnify and filter an image by reading and writing its pixels.
summaryZh: 通过读写像素，实现缩放、水印、放大镜和滤镜。

title: Dragging with mouse events and Pointer Events
titleZh: 用鼠标事件和 Pointer Events 实现拖拽
summary: The same drag written twice; Pointer Events also cover touch and pen.
summaryZh: 同一个拖拽写两遍；Pointer Events 同时支持触屏和手写笔。

title: Swipe to change pages
summary: Turn a swipe into a page change using distance and speed thresholds, with touch events and with Pointer Events.
summaryZh: 用距离和速度阈值把滑动变成翻页，分别用 touch 事件和 Pointer Events 实现。

title: 3D carousel and CSS Scroll Snap
summary: Place layered slides with geometry, then let CSS Scroll Snap do similar work natively.
summaryZh: 用几何计算排布层叠的轮播图，再让 CSS Scroll Snap 原生完成类似的事。

title: Photo wall with CSS transforms
summary: Scattered, tilted cards that straighten and zoom in on hover.
summaryZh: 散落倾斜的卡片，鼠标悬停时摆正并放大。

title: Search suggestions with the keyboard
titleZh: 可以用键盘操作的搜索建议
summary: Filter suggestions as you type and choose one with the arrow keys, using accessible combobox markup.
summaryZh: 边输入边筛选建议，用方向键选择；使用无障碍的 combobox 标记。

title: Menu, step bar and progress ring
titleZh: 导航、步骤条与环形进度
summary: An expanding menu (JavaScript tween vs CSS transition), a step bar and a `conic-gradient` progress ring.
summaryZh: 展开的导航（JS 补间与 CSS 过渡对比）、步骤条，以及用 `conic-gradient` 画的环形进度。

title: Prize wheel
summary: Spin a wheel that always stops on the sector it reports, using the Web Animations API.
summaryZh: 转盘停下的扇区和显示的结果始终一致，用 Web Animations API 实现。

title: Visual experiments
summary: Canvas, CSS and pointer experiments that run straight in the browser.
summaryZh: 直接在浏览器里运行的 Canvas、CSS 和指针交互实验。

title: Measuring page speed today
summary: Navigation Timing, PerformanceObserver and Core Web Vitals, measured on your own visit.
summaryZh: 用 Navigation Timing、PerformanceObserver 和 Core Web Vitals 测量你自己的这次访问。

title: Measuring page speed in 2019
summary: How page speed was measured with `performance.timing`, and why those numbers are read differently now.
summaryZh: 当年怎样用 `performance.timing` 测速，以及为什么今天要换一种方式解读。
